verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
-OMUSAAYI-ogw'ensolo
Gwe baayiwa-ab'edda;
Gwonna tegwayinza bibi
Kubibanaazaako.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Yesu Mulpkozi
Omwana gw'endiga;
Ggwe-oyinza okutugyako
ebyonoono byonna.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ssaddaaka yo ntuufu,
Emalamu-ebibi;
-Omusayi gunaaza byonna,
Bye twonoona ku nsi.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ntunuulidde gy'oli,
Ggwe Mukama wange,
Nga njatula-ebibi byange,
Nga mboneredde nnyo.

verse.name: v5
